train.purpose: records that any fitting path consumed (teacher corpora, BC corpora, DAgger rounds, RL rollouts)
train.corpus_note: membership means 'inside a training corpus'. D1's internal v3 val/test shards are corpus records used for checkpoint selection; they are listed here and also touched by model_selection.

dev.purpose: development / candidate-selection panel; never training data

reserved_seeds.note: v4.2.0 README §6 candidate-selection seeds; no run evidence yet, so they are reserved rather than registered as ancestors

dev.note: seeds 1000-1019 are the actual panel; 1040-1099 stay reserved for pre-registered ablations

confirm.purpose: formal confirmation on fresh, unused seeds
confirm.empty_reason: v4.3.0 has not frozen a confirmation batch; the historical batch is recorded in confirm_batches (61300-61399, spent)

adapt.purpose: G410-6 adaptation target: Z/A/S/A-ad on the frozen hold-out families
adapt.empty_reason: no adaptation episode has run yet; the split freezes the target declaration only

reserved_seed_range.note: W10 confirmation range for the adaptation gate; adaptation *training* seeds must be registered in a new revision before any run

quarantine.purpose: records retained on disk but barred from every fitting path
quarantine.note: S1b (dev seeds 1000-1011) was rejected for seed provenance; the records were kept, so they are named here instead of silently ignored

confirm_batches.name: v410-first-stage-confirm
confirm_batches.note: ASSET_SYNC §6: still unused, do not read

confirm_batches.name: v430-adapt-confirm
confirm_batches.note: reserved for the W10 adaptation gate, never for training

confirm_batches.name: v410-g4101-teacher-confirm-s1n
confirm_batches.note: 100 teacher confirmation seeds, 100/100 clears; the range is spent and must not be reused for a new candidate

verified_absent.method: directory listing of the repository root and of Document/Update/Alpha/v4.3.0 (no sealed directory, file or result bundle exists); no payload was opened

sealed.policy: sealed assets/results are never opened and never referenced by a split registry; a sealed path appearing anywhere in this config is rejected (EXECUTION_PLAN §6, v4.1.0 README §4.3/§WP10)

registries_note: the four registries are bound by sha256+digest_scope; changing a registry without re-freezing this config makes validate-splits fail
